five_x1.title: 5x1
five_x1.description: Enter your Jibo's IP address. After you submit, confirm this Home Assistant server's IP on the Jibo. The robot's conversation server will be set to api.5x1.com. The robot name is detected automatically.

data_description.jibo_ip: The Jibo must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

self_host_beefy.title: Self-Host BEefy
self_host_beefy.description: Enter your Jibo's IP address. After you submit, confirm this Home Assistant server's IP on the Jibo. The robot keeps its current conversation server. The robot name is detected automatically.

data_description.jibo_ip: The Jibo must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

openjibo_com.title: OpenJibo.com
openjibo_com.description: Connect to api.openjibo.com. After setup, a pairing code will appear as a Home Assistant notification. Complete pairing in the OpenJibo portal.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this OpenJibo connection.
data_description.jibo_ip: Optional local IP for direct TTS via the jibo.say service.

self_host_openjibo.title: Self-Host OpenJibo
self_host_openjibo.description: Enter your OpenJibo server URL and optional local robot details. After setup, a pairing code will appear as a Home Assistant notification. Complete pairing in the OpenJibo portal.

data_description.server_url: The URL of your OpenJibo server, for example http://192.168.1.10:24605.
data_description.name: A friendly name for this OpenJibo connection.
data_description.jibo_ip: Optional local IP for direct TTS via the jibo.say service.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Jibo. Check the IP and that the robot is on.
error.rejected: The Jibo declined this Home Assistant server.
error.timeout: The Jibo did not confirm in time. Try again.
error.invalid_auth: The Jibo did not return a pairing password.
error.no_screen: The Jibo could not show the confirmation screen.

abort.already_configured: This OpenJibo connection is already configured.

say.name: Speak
say.description: Make one or more Jibo robots speak a message.

robot.name: Robots
robot.description: Select one or more Jibo robots. Leave empty to speak on all configured robots.
